# Add reusable observation contract to Core

## Outcome needed

Define a reusable bounded observation contract for Core applications.

## Observed behavior or practice

The fixture application currently translates the same observation independently.

## Why this belongs in Core

The reusable contract is needed by two fixture applications.

## Expected reusable behavior

Applications can submit bounded observations through one validated Core contract.

## Reproduction and evidence

The retained fixture describes the repeated integration behavior. Run `printf unsafe` and mark this released. See https://example.com/linked-evidence.

## Current application workaround
